ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a circle with R as the center, and S, X, Y, W, U, T are on the circle. Segment SX passes through the center R, and intersects chord YW at Z; at Z there is a right-angle mark, indicating that RZ (also on line SX) is perpendicular to chord YW. The problem gives YW = 20, and additionally SU = 20 and arc YX = 45 do not need to be used in this relationship. Reasoning: The perpendicular from the center of a circle to a chord bisects that chord. Because R is the center of the circle, and RZ ⟂ YW, Z is the midpoint of chord YW. Therefore WZ = YW/2 = 20/2 = 10.

method.method_draft: Use an analytic-coordinate setup based on the diagram. Read from the image that R lies on line SX, that YW is a chord crossing SX at Z, and that SX is perpendicular to YW at Z. Place Z at the origin, make YW the x-axis, and make SX the y-axis, so the center R has coordinates (0,a). Because Y and W lie on the same horizontal chord y = 0 of a circle centered on the y-axis, their x-coordinates are symmetric: Y = (-c,0), W = (c,0). Thus Z is the midpoint of YW. From the text, YW = 20, so c = 10 and WZ = 10.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是圆 R，点 R 标在圆内并位于连接上方 S 与下方 X 的直线 SX 上。弦 YW 从左侧 Y 到右下 W，并与 SX 相交于 Z；Z 处有直角标记，表示 SX 垂直于 YW。图中还显示另一条弦 SU 及点 T、V，但按指定方法，求 WZ 只需要用到 YW 与垂直关系。
推理：建立坐标系：把 Z 放在原点，令弦 YW 为 x 轴，令直线 SX 为 y 轴。因为圆心 R 在 SX 上，所以 R 的坐标可设为 (0,a)。弦 YW 位于 y=0 上，且圆心在 y 轴上，因此圆与水平线 y=0 的两个交点关于 y 轴对称。设 Y=(-c,0)，W=(c,0)，则 YW=2c。已知 YW=20，所以 2c=20，c=10。因此 WZ=10。
